fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld+html) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap) carry title/link-style fields from the Google News sitemap.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld+html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from

tags inside #cuerpo (NOT the ld+json articleBody field, which was found to strip commas from numbers e.g. '1,8%' -> '18%'). Boilerplate lines (JS warning, subscribers-only badge, newsletter CTA, print-edition footer) are filtered out. Always the complete article regardless of paywall status -- Clarin server-renders full HTML even for paywalled pieces.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author name(s), joined comma-separated when ld+json author is a Person list; single org name for wire-style news.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name, extracted from the ld+json publisher object's name.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: List of keywords, split from the ld+json comma-separated keywords string.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, picked from the first ld+json image list item with a url.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream ld+json paywall flag -- a genuine mixed signal on this site (both true and false observed). Never means truncated text; articleBody is always complete regardless.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when isAccessibleForFree is explicitly false.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline from the Google News sitemap news:title (latest mode).

imageCaption.title: Image caption
imageCaption.description: Sitemap image:caption value, CDATA-wrapped upstream and passed through as-is (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
